originalTitle: Luigi Mangione murder trial to have anonymous jury
summary: The judge overseeing the state murder trial ruled the 12-person jury would remain anonymous because of the intense media spotlight on the case.
content:
The jury in the New York state trial of Luigi Mangione will remain anonymous, the judge overseeing the case ruled on Tuesday.

Mangione has pleaded not guilty to the killing of UnitedHealthcare chief executive Brian Thompson outside a Manhattan hotel in December 2024.

The case has been at the centre of an online frenzy between Mangione's backers - many of whom see the 28-year-old as a symbol of the backlash against US healthcare costs - and his critics, who analyse his intentions and possible political views.

In Tuesday's hearing, Judge Gregory Carro decided the 12-person jury would be anonymous to the public because of the intense spotlight on the case.

Mangione attended the final pre-trial hearing dressed in a charcoal grey suit with his hair clipped short. He sat silently at the defence table while his attorneys conferred with the judge.

The trial begins next month, with jury selection scheduled to start on 8 September.

Mangione, if found guilty, could face decades behind bars. He has pleaded not guilty to all charges, including second-degree murder and weapons-related offences.

He faces a separate federal trial next year, in which he has also pleaded not guilty.

Here's what to know about the upcoming trial, and what questions remain.

Mangione's lawyers and prosecutors have traded terse court filings debating how much access the public will have to the trial.

The public are allowed to watch court proceedings in New York, but seating space is often limited for high-profile cases.

Mangione's trial is expected to generate significant media interest from both traditional journalists as well as streamers and social media influencers. Mangione's supporters have demanded more transparency, and frequently post and broadcast from outside court.

On Tuesday, Carro said the court would open an overflow room, which will allow more people to attend.

Listen to The Mangione Podcast: How a murder case fuelled a culture war

Judge rules gun and writings are admissible in Luigi Mangione's New York murder trial

Caro pushed back against prosecutors for raising security concerns about an overflow room, telling them it was not the court's "first rodeo" with blockbuster cases.

The judge also rebuked Mangione's attorneys for their filings, saying any suggestion the district attorney's office was involved in the process "is simply incorrect".

What evidence will be seen by the jury?

One of the most crucial elements of the Mangione case was decided in a multi-day hearing in December, where the judge weighed which evidence prosecutors could present during trial.

Mangione's team wanted to exclude evidence recovered from his Pennsylvania arrest. It alleged that state police improperly seized and searched Mangione's possessions, and did not properly advise him of his constitutional rights before questioning him.

Public spectators leave Mangione's hearing, one of them wearing a shirt that demands officials "open the courtroom".

The defence succeeded in excluding some items, including a gun magazine, cell phone, passport, wallet and computer chip found in Mangione's backpack.

But Judge Gregory Carro allowed at trial a gun and notebook with Mangione's purported writings , viewed as vital to the prosecution.

Prosecutors have unveiled surveillance footage showing the moment Thompson was shot from behind by a hooded individual. They also used footage to piece together Mangione's alleged movements after the shooting, and ballistics and fingerprint evidence they claim bolsters their case.

What might Mangione's defence look like?

Mangione's legal team has yet to unveil its full strategy. So far, his lawyers have not offered a robust alternative theory to the one prosecutors have put forth.

"We do not have, like in 'The Fugitive,' the idea of the one-armed man who's the real killer," said former federal prosecutor Mitchell Epner, referencing the 1993 Harrison Ford thriller about a man wrongly convicted of killing his wife.

Earlier this summer, Mangione's lawyers proposed, then quickly withdrew, an "extreme emotional disturbance" argument.

In such a defence, New York law requires lawyers to show a defendant "acted under the influence of extreme emotional disturbance for which there was a reasonable explanation or excuse".

Extreme emotional disturbance would allow the jury to consider the less severe charge of manslaughter, rather than second-degree murder. But jurors would have to be convinced of the accused's state of mind at the time.

Mangione's defence team leave court. Pictured from left to right: Marc Agnifilo, Karen Friedman Agnifilo, and Jacob Kaplan.

Mangione's team did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

As in every US criminal trial, the burden rests on the prosecution to prove its case to the jury beyond a reasonable doubt, a high legal bar.

"The more his case is about the question of who killed the victim, the easier it is for the prosecution," said Epner.

Epner cited other themes, including healthcare in America, as potential narrative threads that could sway a jury in Mangione's favour.

"The more it's about the other peripheral issues, the harder it is for the prosecution," he said.

chineseTitle: 路易吉·曼吉奥内谋杀案审判将由匿名陪审团进行
chineseSummary: 由于媒体对该案的强烈关注，监督州谋杀案审判的法官裁定 12 人陪审团将保持匿名。
chineseContent:
负责此案的法官周二裁定，纽约州审判路易吉·曼吉奥内 (Luigi Mangione) 的陪审团将保持匿名。

Mangione 对 2024 年 12 月联合医疗保健首席执行官布莱恩·汤普森 (Brian Thompson) 在曼哈顿一家酒店外被杀一事表示无罪。

此案一直是 Mangione 的支持者（其中许多人将这位 28 岁的年轻人视为反对美国医疗保健费用的象征）和他的批评者之间网上热议的焦点，批评者分析了他的意图和可能的政治观点。

在周二的听证会上，法官格雷戈里·卡罗 (Gregory Carro) 决定，由于此案备受关注，12 人陪审团将对公众匿名。

曼吉奥内身穿炭灰色西装，头发剪得很短，出席了最后的预审听证会。当他的律师与法官商讨时，他静静地坐在辩护席旁。

审判将于下个月开始，陪审团选拔计划于 9 月 8 日开始。

曼吉奥内如果被判有罪，可能会面临数十年的监禁。他对所有指控均表示不认罪，包括二级谋杀和武器相关犯罪。

他明年将面临另一项联邦审判，他也在审判中表示无罪。

以下是关于即将到来的审判的信息以及仍然存在的问题。

曼吉奥内的律师和检察官交换了简短的法庭文件，讨论公众将有多少机会参与审判。

纽约允许公众观看法庭诉讼，但对于备受瞩目的案件，座位空间往往有限。

Mangione 的审判预计将引起传统记者、主播和社交媒体影响者的极大兴趣。曼吉奥内的支持者要求提高透明度，并经常在法庭外发帖和广播。

周二，卡罗表示，法院将开设一个溢出室，以便更多的人参加。

收听 Mangione 播客：谋杀案如何引发文化战争

法官裁定枪支和文字在路易吉·曼吉奥内纽约谋杀案审判中可以接受

卡罗反驳了检察官对溢出室提出的安全担忧，并告诉他们这并不是法院“第一次处理重磅案件”。

法官还斥责了曼吉奥内的律师提交的文件，称任何有关地方检察官办公室参与这一过程的说法“都是错误的”。

陪审团会看到哪些证据？

Mangione 案最关键的要素之一是在 12 月举行的为期多天的听证会上做出的决定，法官在听证会上权衡了检察官在审判期间可以提出哪些证据。

曼吉奥内的团队希望排除他在宾夕法尼亚州被捕时发现的证据。据称，州警察不当扣押和搜查了曼吉奥内的财产，并且在审问他之前没有适当告知他宪法权利。

公众观众离开曼焦内的听证会，其中一人穿着一件衬衫，要求官员“开放法庭”。

辩方成功排除了一些物品，包括在曼吉奥内背包中发现的枪弹匣、手机、护照、钱包和电脑芯片。

但格雷戈里·卡罗法官在审判时允许携带一把枪和一本笔记本，上面有据称是曼吉奥内的著作，这些著作被认为对检方至关重要。

检察官公布了监控录像，显示汤普森被一名戴头巾的人从后面开枪的那一刻。他们还利用录像片段拼凑出曼吉奥内在枪击事件后的所谓动作，他们声称弹道和指纹证据支持了他们的案件。

曼吉奥内的防守会是什么样子？

Mangione 的法律团队尚未公布其完整战略。到目前为止，他的律师还没有提供一种强有力的替代理论来替代检察官提出的理论。

前联邦检察官米切尔·埃普纳 (Mitchell Epner) 表示：“我们并不像《逃亡者》中那样，认为独臂男子才是真正的凶手。”他指的是 1993 年哈里森·福特 (Harrison Ford) 执导的惊悚片，该片讲述了一名男子因杀害妻子而被错误定罪的故事。

今年夏天早些时候，曼吉奥内的律师提出了“极度情绪困扰”的论点，但很快就撤回了。

在这样的辩护中，纽约法律要求律师证明被告“在极端情绪困扰的影响下采取行动，并有合理的解释或借口”。

极度的情绪困扰将使陪审团考虑较轻的过失杀人罪指控，而不是二级谋杀罪。但陪审员必须确信被告当时的心态。

曼吉奥内的辩护团队离开法庭。图片从左到右：马克·阿格尼菲洛、凯伦·弗里德曼·阿格尼菲洛和雅各布·卡普兰。

Mangione 的团队没有立即回应置评请求。

与美国的每一次刑事审判一样，检方有责任向陪审团证明其案件毫无合理怀疑，这是一个很高的法律门槛。

埃普纳说：“他的案件越是涉及谁杀了受害者的问题，起诉就越容易。”

埃普纳引用了其他主题，包括美国的医疗保健，作为潜在的叙事线索，可能会影响陪审团对曼吉奥内的支持。

“越涉及其他外围问题，起诉就越困难，”他说。
